mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Verify and record the remote default branch.

acceptedEvidence.claim: Live origin currently advertises refs/heads/main as HEAD without making that name a permanent assumption.

allowedReads: Live remote HEAD symref and branch heads
Repository workflows and scripts containing branch-name assumptions
exclusions: No ref, branch, index, worktree, workflow, or source mutation
No fetch, checkout, merge, push, or default-branch change
No claim that the current name main is permanent
No unrelated workflow remediation in this leaf
acceptanceGate: The contract resolves default by remote metadata rather than assuming the name main.
oneFixPlan: Define and validate a metadata-driven default-branch resolution contract, record the current resolved ref, and inventory hard-coded exceptions.
validationCommand: Re-read the live remote symref, test fallback and renamed-default fixtures, scan scoped branch assumptions, and verify zero Git mutation.
cancellationRule: Stop before changing any repository or hosting setting.
